state:
**Goal `tooling-overhaul`, Stages 9 and 10 are done, and Stage 11 is in progress.** The cutover is on `main`. `main` stays frozen, and tag `pre-overhaul` is the rollback.

`bun nv lints` replaces `tools/lints.py`, which is deleted (`tools/nv/cmd/lints.ts`, test `tools/nv/test/lints.test.ts`). `UNSAFE_CRATES` and `EXCEPTIONS` now live in that file, and `docs/plan/design.md` § *Unsafe policy* points there. A write edits only the lint region, so a table after it survives, writes LF, and puts every manifest back if `cargo metadata` then fails. `nv verify`'s `lints` step and the CI `lint` job run it through Bun, and that job no longer sets up Python.

`bun nv audit ci` still exits 1 and is the red Stage 11 check, an open item and not a regression. It names 9 workflow steps that run `python tools/release.py`, and the two website sync scripts. No git hook calls Python.

`bun nv loop --owed` and `--settle` exist, and `tools/git-hooks/pre-push` calls them. `tools/playbook.py`'s module doc still lists the `reviewed` kind. That file goes in Stage 12.

next.title: the last Python steps in CI

items.text: **Port `release` to `bun nv release`** -- `tools/release.py:1` is 685 lines: `--check`, `--notes`, `--apply`, `--package`, `--docker-tags`. Read manifests with `smol-toml` and write by line-scoped edits checked by `cargo metadata`, the way `tools/nv/cmd/lints.ts:1` does. The pin bump at `tools/release.py:436` must bump every pin that `tools/release.py:530` checks. Then `.github/workflows/ci.yml:596`, `.github/workflows/release.yml:140` and `.github/workflows/release-promote.yml:98` run `bun nv release`, and each job drops `setup-python` if nothing else in it needs Python. Add a unit test in `tools/nv/test/`.

**Delete the website sync scripts** -- `website/scripts/sync-rules.mjs:1` and `website/scripts/sync-core.mjs:1`. Their data comes from `bun nv render --website`, which `tools/nv/cmd/render.ts:1` does not have yet. Then `bun nv audit ci` exits 0, checked by `tools/nv/cmd/audit.ts:1`.
